text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is finally about
to 
begin. Once again today,
Biwa Hayahide can 
be seen in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Narita Brian exchanged 
words with Oguri Cap. She declared that 
she couldn't afford to lose, if only for 
the folks back home in Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vowing to give it their absolute all, the 
two head toward the battleground—!
